references.text: Earlier instruction to buy food and water with money from the descendants of Esau, establishing the principle of trade during the journey
Israel's request to Edom for passage through their land and an offer to pay for food and water
Similar request to Sihon, king of the Amorites, for peaceful passage without taking food or water without payment
The concept of buying grain with money, showing trade for necessities of life
Prophetic invitation to buy food and water, contrasting with the literal trade in the wilderness
